scope: Design and existing frozen/live call boundaries only. This is not implementation/proof/native acceptance. No builds, tests or decoder execution.
observed_existing_boundaries: Both frozen whole-decoder timed loops invoke Impl.decode directly, including its complete result. CPR immediately routes that result through the unchanged tracking policy.
Frozen test adapters call Impl.decode/decodePrefix or existing live specialized APIs. No alternate decoder is required or permitted.
FrameRoundTrip.encode_decode covers every successfully decoded byte list, retaining every spare/reserved field; RawSyndromeSpec can use it without a corpus assumption.
Current standalone frameSyndrome, frameAccepted, frameAddress and report have arbitrary Frame semantics; those interfaces must remain meaningful and live.
Current decoder rejects malformed lengths and unsupported DF before computing its syndrome; later semantic/parity rejection already follows a pure syndrome computation.
implementation_proof_obligations: Live parser helper result is the exact old Frame paired with the already computed bytesValue, with identical failure behavior for every List UInt8.
Public decodeFrame delegates to/projectively consumes that same live helper; main decode uses it once and does not re-read bytes.
Raw syndrome width informationBits frame.body + 24 agrees with full parsed 56/112-bit width, including DF19 and the two-bit Comm-D descriptor.
Full-word syndrome equals checksum(information) XOR transmitted parity for every successfully parsed byte list; all parity/address/interrogator/DF17 acceptance meanings preserved.
All original theorem statements, full report fields and both existing Comm-B inference uses remain unchanged; only proof bodies/imports may bridge the new representation.
All compiled facts list only permitted axioms, with kernel witnesses spanning failure/success, short/long, reserved-bit and parity boundaries.
No changes to frozen files, runtime trust boundary, tested-only Float callbacks or corpus-specific behavior.
native_review_plan: Bind coordinated integration, current source/generated C/object/trace and actual linked worker for all 22 production sets; inspect selected function disassemblies only.
Confirm one live parser/raw-word acquisition and one full-word Parity.syndrome path from main decode, with acceptance/report using the identical computed syndrome.
Confirm no direct frameParts/packFields/frameSyndrome reconstruction and no second bytesValue call on the main path, without claiming absent standalone symbols imply zero generic work.
Inspect helper inlining and pair construction/ownership explicitly; no allocation or throughput claim without actual evidence.
Future diagnostic classifiers must attribute the new parser helper to frame/CRC and observe direct Parity.syndrome calls instead of assuming retired main frameSyndrome/checksum/packFields counts.
